transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because my sleep has gotten really messed up. I work overnight shifts, and even when I get off and I’m exhausted, I’ll just lie there wide awake. Then if I do finally fall asleep, I wake up scared, and it feels like I didn’t rest at all.
Do you ever wake up suddenly during the night feeling extremely scared, confused, or with a racing heart, even if you don’t remember a nightmare?

Yeah… that does happen. I’ll finally doze off after my shift, and then I’ll wake up scared, like something’s wrong, even if I don’t really remember a dream. My sleep just feels broken up, and I wake up feeling like I didn’t rest at all.
Do these sudden awakenings with fear or confusion happen specifically when you're trying to sleep at night, or can they happen at any time when you're resting?
It’s mostly when I’m trying to sleep after my overnight shift. I’ll be really tired but still can’t fall asleep, and then if I do drift off, I wake up scared and feel like I didn’t rest at all.
When you're awake, do you often feel unusually worried, tense, or on edge, even when there's no specific reason for it?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I feel worried all the time for no reason… I mostly just notice it around trying to sleep or when I wake up like that.
When you're awake and not trying to sleep, do you ever feel anxious or worried for no clear reason, or do your worries usually have a specific cause?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed feeling anxious out of nowhere when I’m just awake. If I’m worried, it’s usually about something specific, not just for no reason.
When you're fully awake, have you ever had sudden episodes of intense fear or discomfort that came out of nowhere and included physical symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or shortness of breath?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed that happening when I’m fully awake. It’s more around when I’m trying to sleep or waking up, not just out of nowhere during the day.
Have you ever woken up and been unable to move or speak for a short period of time, either right after waking up or sometimes while falling asleep?

I don’t think I’ve been unable to move or talk like that. It’s more that my sleep is really broken up now. I get off my overnight shift and I’m still lying there wide awake, and then when I finally do fall asleep, I wake up scared and feel like I didn’t rest at all.
When you're awake and not trying to sleep, have you ever had upsetting thoughts, images, or worries that kept coming back and caused you a lot of distress?

Yes. I keep going back over things in my head, like every little thing I might’ve done wrong with my patients or with my family. It just keeps coming back, and I start feeling like I’m a worthless aide… like I didn’t protect people the way I should have. Sometimes it feels like God is mad at me for that.
Do these upsetting thoughts often feel like they're connected to something traumatic or very disturbing that you experienced before?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think it’s tied to one specific traumatic thing. It’s more like worries and guilt that keep coming back, about things I feel I did wrong.
Do these upsetting thoughts feel like they’re not really you, or do they feel more like something you believe is true about yourself?

They feel true… that’s the hard part. It doesn’t feel like some random thought that isn’t me. I keep thinking about every little thing I did wrong with patients or my family, and it feels like I really am a worthless aide. Like I didn’t protect people the way I should have, and God is mad at me for it.
Do these thoughts about feeling worthless and not protecting people enough happen most days, and have they been going on for more than two weeks?

Yes… it’s most days. It’s been going on for more than two weeks. I keep going over every little thing I think I did wrong with patients or with my family, and it just feels true that I’m a worthless aide… like God is mad at me because I didn’t protect people better.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, most days?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to that. I know I don’t feel like myself, but I can’t say for sure about enjoying things less.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure or interest in activities or things you used to enjoy, on most days?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been paying attention to whether I enjoy things less. I just know I don’t feel right, but I can’t say for sure about that.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even things you used to really like doing?
I’m still not sure. I haven’t really been paying attention to whether I enjoy things or not. I just feel off, but I don’t know how to answer that exactly.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even things you used to really like doing?
I really don’t know. I haven’t been thinking about it like that, like whether I enjoy things or not. I just know I don’t feel like myself.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, most days?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed it in that exact way, like less pleasure. I just haven’t been thinking about things I used to enjoy much.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, most days?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been keeping track of that, like if it’s most days or not. I just… I’m not sure how to tell.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, most days?
I’m sorry, I still don’t really know how to answer that. I haven’t been paying attention to whether I enjoy things or not most days. I just feel off, but I can’t say for sure about that.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, most days?
I really don’t know. I haven’t noticed it clearly like that, and I don’t want to say yes if I’m not sure.
